page_title: WHU 3-0 WOL | West Ham v Wolves 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Thilo Kehrer (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Wolves are ruled offside.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vladimir Coufal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Thilo Kehrer (West Ham).
90+1' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+1' Wolves concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
87' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
86' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Divin Mubama (West Ham) replacing Lucas Paqueta.
86' A substitution has been made. Mohammed Kudus goes off and Danny Ings (West Ham) comes on.
82' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
80' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Mario Lemina will be replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
80' Substitution. Nelson Semedo makes way for Matt Doherty (Wolves).
80' A clumsy foul by Nelson Semedo (Wolves) and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. West Ham get a free kick.
78' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
76' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
74' 3 - 0 Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) dribbles into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. Sensational solo goal.

73' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Chris Kavanagh saw the whole situation. Wolves win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
70' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) replaces Toti.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pablo Fornals (West Ham) for Edson Alvarez.
70' Mario Lemina (Wolves) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
66' Mario Lemina (Wolves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Lukasz Fabianski easily deals with the threat.
64' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
64' A cross into the box from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is cleared.
61' The goal by Wolves is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
59' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Wolves players aren’t happy.
58' Goal - 2:1! Nelson Semedo laid the ball off to Pablo Sarabia (Wolves), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
57' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
56' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
56' The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

54' He should have scored! Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.

49' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
49' There's an opportunity for James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
48' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for West Ham.
47' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle after Craig Dawson (Wolves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Chris Kavanagh has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
45+5' Referee Chris Kavanagh halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Gary O'Neil, then shows him a yellow.

45+5' Toti (Wolves) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Toti (Wolves) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+4' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Kurt Zouma (West Ham), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Toti (Wolves) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' What a great touch by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
45' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
44' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement. Wolves win a free kick.
42' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
41' The corner from Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is intercepted by the defence.
41' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.
40' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
40' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' The resulting corner, taken by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), comes to nothing.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
37' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' One of the Wolves players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.

32' 2 - 0 GOAL! A great pass finds Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 2:0.
31' Wow, what an escape. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
30' A player from Wolves brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
29' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

28' Lukasz Fabianski makes a brilliant save! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper! The linesman points to the corner flag, Wolves are going to take it.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

23' 1 - 0 GOAL! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from mid range to make it 1:0.
22' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
22' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
19' Daniel Bentley reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) towards the bottom left corner.

17' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul. West Ham will take a free kick.
17' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
16' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. West Ham will take a corner kick.

15' Vladimir Coufal sends a lofted pass into the box, Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) shows good awareness to connect with it but drags his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
14' The referee blows his whistle as Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was too aggressive in his challenge.

12' A pass travels right across the box to Matheus Cunha (Wolves) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Fabianski denies him with a decent save.
11' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
8' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
8' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) launches a cross from the corner, but Daniel Bentley is alert to thwart the effort. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
7' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and West Ham manage to earn a corner.
6' The resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is cleared by the defence.
5' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) inside the box following a slide rule pass. West Ham have a corner.
4' West Ham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Wolves will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Chris Kavanagh.
